subject: GPU roster assurance for Crescendo Labs - late-stage sizing
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GPU roster assurance for Crescendo Labs - late-stage sizing

Team —

Crescendo Labs (HS-987654) just pushed to contract review. They want predictable Dedicated capacity starting mid-September for an initial production ramp. Ask from sales/solutions: can we surface a capacity assertion (soft pledge) for the following footprint and timeline so they can proceed with procurement?

Background: Crescendo will run a mixture of 2.7B and 13B models, quantized to int8 for cost, with a peak expected QPS of ~75 across 12 routes. They want 24/7 availability and regional locality in us-west. SLA: 99.9 p95 latency target for 2k token windows.

Requested footprint (target go-live window: 2027-09-15 to 2028-03-15):
- 20 x A100-80GB (in dedicated pool us-west)
- 10 x H100-equivalent for burst (training-simulated workloads at scale)
- 100 concurrent sessions with KV caching enabled

Files attached: crescendo_capacity_request.xlsx (spreadsheet with model mix and token projections), Crescendo_SOW_v2.pdf (commercial terms).

What I need from you:
1) Preliminary availability (yes/no) for that footprint and approximate confidence level (low/medium/high).
2) Any blockers (e.g., maintenance windows, planned upgrades, capacity pressure from existing reserves) and suggested mitigations.
3) Recommendation on whether we can offer a 30-day soft-pledge (internal hold flag) that we convert to a formal reservation once legal signals green.

Timing: customer is asking for a written note this week to include in procurement pack.

Thanks —
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GPU roster assurance for Crescendo Labs - late-stage sizing

Karthik —

Quick read: footprint requested is non-trivial but plausible. Immediate notes from capacity planning:
- Current pool us-west dedicated has ~38 A100 equivalents free today, but 12 of those are earmarked for Q3 commitments (internal soft-holds). Usable headroom without churn: ~26 A100 equiv.
- H100-equivalent burst is tight; we have ~6 nodes that can be repurposed but would require mitigation steps (driver/kernel window and node reboot risk).

Blockers: two maintenance windows scheduled Aug 18-20 for kernel/runtime updates; we can avoid impacting a soft-pledge by pinning to a compatible execution image, but that reduces scheduling flexibility.

Recommendation: we can provide a 30-day soft-pledge for the A100s at medium confidence, and a conditional soft-pledge for H100-equivalents (low confidence) pending rebalancing or a short-term borrow from the shared burst pool. I will open CAP-3214 to track this.

Action items I can take now:
- Create internal soft-hold ticket and tag nodes 20xA100 (soft)
- Schedule a preflight runbook for Aug 10 to confirm reboots won't impact their windows

If you want a written one-paragraph to hand to procurement, I can draft it.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Capacity Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 08:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GPU roster assurance for Crescendo Labs - late-stage sizing

Thanks Ben — adding a few ops-level details: 

1) Runtime image pinning: we can pin Crescendo to runtime-2027-06-15 which avoids the Aug maintenance risk. That will require us to replicate that image across the nodes we plan to soft-pledge. Ops time: ~4 hours to replicate and validate.

2) KV cache behavior: recommend enabling prefix caching on the first 4 nodes to reduce model memory pressure; ops can prewarm cache if Crescendo shares sample prompts (ask them).

3) Soft-hold process: we treat the soft-hold as an internal annotation only (no billing change). If legal confirms SOW within 30 days, we convert to a reservation ticket (and notify finance). I suggest adding a “soft-hold: cres-987” tag on the nodes.

I will add runbook steps to CAP-3214 and estimate required ops FTE: 0.8 days.

-Soojin
Soojin Lee
Lead Systems Engineer, Dedicated Pools | Redwood Inference
From: Emma Huang <emma@crescendolabs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@crescendolabs.com>, procurement@crescendolabs.com
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 12:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GPU roster assurance for Crescendo Labs - late-stage sizing

Karthik —

Appreciate the speed. We are aligned to aim for Sept 15 go-live window. A couple clarifications from our side:
- We will accept a 30-day soft-pledge while legal wraps the final SOW; Crescendo is comfortable with an internal annotation as long as we get confirmation in writing.
- If you need sample prompts / prefix cache inputs for prewarming, I can share a sanitized set by Friday.

Attached: Crescendo_SOW_v2.pdf (redlines highlighted) — we will push the DocuSign envelope once the capacity note is in writing.

Emma Huang
Head of Platform | Crescendo Labs
emma@crescendolabs.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Emma Huang <emma@crescendolabs.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GPU roster assurance for Crescendo Labs - late-stage sizing

Ben / Soojin —

Thanks for the quick run. Emma confirmed Crescendo will accept a 30-day internal soft-pledge. Please: 

1) Create the soft-hold tag (soft-hold:cres-987) on the 20 A100 nodes and the conditional tag on up to 6 H100-equivalents.
2) Note the HubSpot deal id HS-987654 in the ticket and link the SOW (DocuSign pending).
3) Add the Aug 10 preflight checkpoint to the ticket and assign to Jonas for validation.

If we can get a one-paragraph confirmation I’ll include in the procurement package for Crescendo Legal.

Karthik
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GPU roster assurance for Crescendo Labs - late-stage sizing

Karthik —

Soft-hold created: CAP-3214 updated with tags soft-hold:cres-987. Node allocation: 18 A100s tagged immediately, 2 A100s are warm-standby pending decommission of an internal test pool (ETA 8/9). 4 H100-equivalents tagged as conditional; another 2 marked as eligible but require swap-out.

HubSpot link added to CAP-3214 and SOW attached. Preflight checkpoint scheduled for 2027-08-10 10:00 PT, assigned to Jonas Weber. Runbook notes added for runtime pin and cache prewarm (Soojin).

One-paragraph confirmation you can give procurement: 

"Redwood Inference confirms a 30-day internal soft-pledge of 20 A100-class nodes (us-west dedicated pool) and conditional tagging of up to 6 H100-equivalent nodes for Crescendo Labs (Deal HS-987654). This soft-pledge is an internal capacity annotation and will be converted to a formal reservation upon SOW execution. Planned preflight validation is scheduled for 2027-08-10. -- Redwood Capacity Operations"

I also attached the CAP ticket link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CAP-3214

—Ben
